text: Freeman joins your part at no cost (except food and lodging), he is combat skill 3, endurance 4.
Lancer with a horse can be hired for 3 gold per day, he is combat skill 5, endurance 5.
One or two mercenaries can be hired for 2 gold per day each. Each is combat skill 4, endurance 4.
Horse dealer in area, you can buy horses (for mounts) at 10 gold each.
Local guide available (see r205), hires for 2 gold per day, has combat skill 2, endurance 3.
Henchmen available, roll one die for the number available for hire, each is combat skill 3, endurance 3, and costs 1 gold per day each.
Nothing available, but you gain some news and information, see r209 but subtract one (-1) from your dice roll there.
Honest horse dealer in area, can buy horses (for mounts) at 7 gold each.
Runaway boy or girl joins your party at no cost (except food and lodging), has combat skill 1, endurance 3.
Porters in any quantity available, hire for gold each per day. In addition, a local guide (r205) can be hired for 2 gold per day, has combat skill 1, endurance 2.
